info.description: Clean, lightweight, and idiomatic Go backend for warehouse inventory and transactional ordering.
info.title: Warehouse REST API Testbench

post.description: Authenticate an admin user and return a JWT token with admin claims

get.description: Retrieve all orders across the system for administrative auditing and fulfillment

patch.description: Update the lifecycle status of an order. Administrators can only transition PROCESSED orders to CANCELLED (which automatically refunds customer balance and restores product stock). FAILED orders cannot be altered.

get.description: Retrieve full unrestricted product inventory for administrators

post.description: Add a new product item with arbitrary category, manufacturer, model, price, and stock
post.summary: Add a new product to warehouse

patch.description: Set stock quantity for a warehouse product

get.description: Query paginated list of users with optional role filtering

post.description: Create a new admin or regular user account

get.description: Retrieve a specific user account by UUID

delete.description: Marks user as deactivated/deleted while preserving immutable historical order records

post.description: Increases the user account balance by a specified increment amount (minimum 0.01)
post.summary: Top up user balance by an increment

put.description: Set allowed categories and manufacturers for a user. Empty array removes restrictions.
put.summary: Configure catalog access filters for a user

post.description: Authenticate a regular user and return a JWT token with user claims

get.description: Returns all orders placed by the authenticated user

post.description: Atomically purchases a product item, decrements stock, and deducts user balance

400.description: Malformed JSON syntax or schema validation failure

422.description: Domain business rule violation (INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, INSUFFICIENT_STOCK, FILTER_RESTRICTION)

get.description: Returns details for a specific order placed by the authenticated user
Browse warehouse items with optional category/manufacturer filters, sorting, and pagination

200.description: List of allowed products with pagination

400.description: Invalid pagination, sorting, or filter parameters
